summary: Retry transient Git snapshot invalidations in worktree overlap ticket_scopes

delivery.outcome: Retry transient Git state or ticket inventory invalidations up to 3 attempts inside worktree_overlap_check.ticket_scopes so concurrent sibling ref/worktree updates do not trigger spurious GOV-TICKET-ACTIVITY-001 aborts, while preserving per-attempt snapshot consistency and fail-closed reporting on persistent churn or document corruption.
nonGoals: Do not weaken ActivityReadBatch snapshot validation or suppress persistent Git churn across all retry attempts.
Do not retry activity document tampering or invalid receipt registries.

architecture.decision: Wrap the read-only ActivityReadBatch loop in scripts/worktree_overlap_check.py:ticket_scopes in a bounded 3-attempt retry (50ms/100ms backoff) restricted to transient Git/inventory invalidation messages, resetting partial scopes/errors between attempts and failing closed on exhaustion.
architecture.rollback: Revert this bounded commit via protected PR delivery.

validation.evidence: Transient Git ref updates mid-batch recover cleanly on retry while persistent churn and registry tampering still fail closed.
Repository governance and Wellman standards checks pass with 0 errors.
